# The vault library, vendored

Copied unedited on 22 October 2026 from newsroom.sgit.ai, which runs the same library as dev.vault.sgraph.ai (sg-vault v0.2.3, twelve files, plus one local extension), and the newsroom's wrapper assets/newsroom-vault.js (here assets/vault/newsroom-vault.js). One code base writes vaults: this site calls the wrapper and writes none of the format itself. Loaded only by the phone app (now/), and only when a vault is opened.
